row.name: Jetpack Fuel
row.description: Highly volatile, compressed gas mixture optimized for personal flight systems. Can be dispensed to a Jetpack Fuel Tank directly, or into a Chemical Storage Vessel. Kinetic Breach (Pierced/Slashed): The highly pressurized gas violently vents. If the jetpack is currently being worn, the sudden, asymmetrical thrust throws the user out of control. The wearer must make an immediate DX-4 or Piloting (Flight Pack)-4 roll. On a failure, they are thrown 1d yards in a random direction and knocked prone, taking 1d crushing damage from the impact. The jetpack is rendered useless. Ignition / Energy Breach (Shot by Blaster): The volatile flight gas detonates. Damage: Deals 4d crushing explosive (cr ex) and 2d burning (burn) damage directly to the wearer. Area Effect: The explosion affects a 3-yard radius. Standard explosion fall-off rules apply for collateral damage.
